scope: Recorded local v15d2 reception before the PR commit and before addition of these two documentation files. A later commit or GitHub job has its own identity and result.

five_gaps.name: Dependent Bundle and remapping
five_gaps.scope: Complete dependent Bundle, domain identities, effective transfer and restart within declared schemas and capacities; the author controls conservation of the transfer.

five_gaps.name: Complete continuation and children at evolving frontiers
five_gaps.scope: Complete continuation, provisional children, one-time consumption, reassessment and atomic publication with reached time and explicit budgets.

five_gaps.name: Closure under spatial composition
five_gaps.scope: Normative Array/Bundle/Use/Realize/solve composition in the real System; restrictions of legacy Field adapters remain separate.

five_gaps.name: Closed distributed algebra profile
five_gaps.scope: Closed distributed algebra in the CPU profile with contiguous ownership, declared ordering, a fixed communicator and finite capacities.

five_gaps.name: AD and adjoints
five_gaps.scope: JVP/VJP and implicit derivatives under declared dualities and domains; finite traces remain distinct from selected solutions, without a scalable-cost promise.

postfreeze_extension.conception: New Python law and method authored after engine freeze v15d; executed on v15d2 through an explicit one-file CI-metadata transition. Not a new v15d2 birth and not an earlier execution renamed.
postfreeze_extension.scope: 64 replicated sites on six axes; Hamiltonian composition with signed substeps, MPI2, four steps and checkpoint/restart. No native continuum-order, exact energy conservation, GPU or scaling qualification.

verification_boundaries: C17 is source correspondence, not an execution trace.
Program command strings were recorded with redaction; 43 model-block sidecars retain authenticated original compile commands.
The corpus alone retains complete_api_02_conformance=false; the scoped decisions use the full evidence index.
No prior reception was relabelled as a new source or environment.
Binary artifacts, logs and local absolute paths are not published by this summary.
backend_limits: Finite arrays use host C++ loops and std::vector storage within real PoPS/Kokkos/MPI.
No GPU or multinode performance qualification.
Contiguous ownership, fixed communicator and explicit finite capacities; no restart at arbitrary rank count or MPI fault recovery.
Legacy Field/MultiFab/StencilFlux adapters keep their own restrictions.
Topology changes and nondifferentiable selections require explicit rules; columnwise VJPs may be expensive.

profiles.limitation: Periodic smooth data; no general boundary or convergence qualification.
Selected data are effectively one-dimensional; shocks and general entropy behavior are unqualified.

profiles.selected_profile: Compressible Euler with a pressure-offset EOS
profiles.limitation: One EOS and smooth periodic profile; no all-state positivity or shock qualification.
One positive-definite constant tensor; nonlinear and discontinuous tensors are unqualified.

profiles.selected_profile: Compressible Navier–Stokes with temperature-dependent viscosity and heat conduction
profiles.limitation: Planar profile; balance/minimum checks alone do not distinguish a cyclic permutation of the state.

profiles.selected_profile: Enthalpy diffusion with a latent-heat plateau
profiles.limitation: One piecewise-linear temperature law; no general Stefan-interface convergence claim.
Stationary lake-at-rest profile cannot distinguish a no-op; dynamic wetting/drying is not qualified.
Field constraints and balances do not constitute a complete trajectory oracle.
Explicit SSPRK2 profile, not Hoffart midpoint/Schur or an AP/quasi-neutral qualification.
Selected coefficients and finite mesh; constraints and balances are not a full trajectory oracle.
Three selected species with a common flux constraint; arbitrary mixtures are unqualified.
2D3V kinematics with zero third central heat moment; not a fitted general closure.
One photo group and chosen rates; data invariant in the transverse direction.

profiles.selected_profile: Cold two-fluid sheath and a capacitive circuit
profiles.limitation: Pressureless selected regime; no universal sheath or circuit model qualification.
The corpus selects the smooth order-four profile; other orders/regimes need their own evidence.
Universal hyperbolicity is false for an admissible oblique state; this finite success does not restore it.

profiles.selected_profile: Regularized Fan–Li15 with a nonconservative path
profiles.limitation: One raw-moment segment path and finite profile; no universal path or stability claim.

profiles.selected_profile: Entropy closure M2 with six quadrature nodes
profiles.limitation: Finite quadrature and selected nonlinear closure; not all orders or continuum velocity space.
Truncated reduced phase space; not 3x3v, stiff/AP BGK or an H-theorem qualification.
Chosen moment constraints and velocity discretization; no general multispecies theorem.
Fixed transverse symbol; not full-f 5D, transverse ExB transport or tokamak geometry.

profiles.selected_profile: Grey M1 radiation coupled to Euler matter
profiles.limitation: One closure and exchange model; no universal optically stiff/AP claim.
Ohmic resistivity is disabled by default; no general Hall stability or boundary qualification.
Chosen interface pressure/velocity and path; the realization oracle shares constitutive expressions.

profiles.selected_profile: GPR thermomechanics with distortion and thermal impulse
profiles.limitation: The oracle shares constitutive expressions; stiff limits and universal determinant preservation are unqualified.
One cosine interaction kernel; finite energy checks are not a continuum convergence theorem.
One quartic potential and discretization; no arbitrary mobility or unconditional fully discrete guarantee.
Default uniform state tests geometric conservation; not every nonuniform ALE problem.
One coupled guiding-center profile; stiff order and arbitrary couplings remain unqualified.

profiles.selected_profile: IMEX Euler: local decay and global backward diffusion
profiles.limitation: Linear selected split; no general high-order IMEX or AP claim.
One solvable ODE and endpoint contract; not arbitrary boundary-driven splitting.

profiles.selected_profile: Coupled elliptic blocks with a Schur solve
profiles.limitation: Selected symmetric positive-definite operator; not arbitrary nonsymmetric blocks or preconditioners.

profiles.selected_profile: Outer implicit update with an inner entropy Newton closure
profiles.limitation: Two-velocity finite closure; no singular-root or branch-selection differentiation claim.

profiles.selected_profile: Nonlinear argument partition in two residuals
profiles.limitation: Two scalar residuals distinguish old/new arguments; not a general partitioning theorem.

profiles.selected_profile: Variable-step BDF2 with genuine retained history
profiles.limitation: Selected decay equation and startup; AMR history transfer is not part of this profile.

profiles.selected_profile: Subcycling/reflux on a partially refined hierarchy
profiles.limitation: Default hierarchy is frozen and accepts; parent rejection and remap refusal are separate tests.

profiles.selected_profile: Two-velocity spatial BGK with a Duhamel interval flux
profiles.limitation: Frozen local equilibrium; not a complete nonlinear UGKS/AP or arbitrary ADER qualification.

profiles.selected_profile: Relaxed Heun rotation with actual reached time
profiles.limitation: One quadratic invariant and relaxation law; arbitrary invariants are unqualified.
Default circulation is zero; empty species and nonzero circulation are separate tests.

profiles.selected_profile: Euler face-flux correction: Richtmyer to shared Rusanov
profiles.limitation: One correction pass and EOS; not a general MOOD loop, coupled-field recalculation or AMR reflux method.
